seo.description: Print designs onto your coffee foam in one press. Choose 1, 2 or 3 cameras and 4 or 12 stencils. A gift for coffee lovers. Free shipping on every order.

how.title: Latte art in four easy steps
how.intro: No barista skills needed. Load a stencil, press, and your design appears in the foam.
how.imageAlt: The cream latte art camera on a table with a stencil card loaded

steps.title: Fill the tray
steps.text: Spoon cocoa, cinnamon or fine coffee powder into the holder.

steps.title: Load a stencil
steps.text: Slide a stencil card into the camera, like loading film.

steps.title: Press over the cup
steps.text: Hold the camera above your drink and press the button.

steps.title: Sip and share
steps.text: A name, a pattern or a greeting appears in the foam.

features.title: From powder to pattern in four moves
features.text: Spoon cocoa or fine coffee powder into the holder, slide a stencil card into the camera, press it over your cup, and lift. Your design is left in the foam.
features.imageAlt: Four numbered photos: filling the powder tray, loading a stencil, pressing the camera over a cup, and a finished SUMMER latte

features.title: Even QR-style patterns
features.text: Stencils go well past lettering: shapes, patterns and QR-style designs dust onto the foam just as easily.
features.imageAlt: A latte with a QR-style pattern in cocoa powder beside stencil cards and the camera

features.title: Short phrases for every moment
features.text: Chill, But first coffee, You got this, Pretty. Swap the card to match the mood, the guest or the occasion.
features.imageAlt: A sheet of stencil cards reading Chill, But first coffee, You got this and Pretty
